seed_policy: Fresh attempt state; repetition index plus one. Input and contract hashes stored in every experiment.

tasks.title: Read-only project inspection
tasks.scorer: findings, non-issue, file/line evidence and matching artifact

tasks.title: Recovery and empty evidence
tasks.fault: first primary read fails for each independent worker
tasks.scorer: answer, observed failure, empty response and bounded per-worker requests

tasks.title: Conflicting evidence and unknowns
tasks.scorer: authoritative constraint, cited decision and explicit unknown

answer_key_policy: Evaluator-only expected() function; never registered as an agent tool or placed in fixture documents. Expected values appear only in completed evaluation evidence.
